name: PaddleOCR-VL
paper_title: PaddleOCR-VL: Boosting Multilingual Document Parsing via a 0.9B Ultra-Compact Vision-Language Model
license_interpretation: Apache-2.0 is a permissive license, so the PaddleOCR-VL-0.9B recognizer and the PP-DocLayoutV2 layout detector can be used in commercial and closed-source products. Redistributing them means keeping the license text and attribution notices, and the license grants a patent license. Both networks run through the Apache-2.0 Hugging Face Transformers classes; LibreYOLO ports only the document-parsing pipeline (layout post-processing, prompt routing, markdown conversion) from PaddleX at commit 4c968d30b9d0d4a693d9eaaef0881c20f8d7d0e0, also Apache-2.0 (libreyolo/models/paddleocrvl/NOTICE), and the rest of the adapter is MIT. The weights are an unmodified, ungated mirror at LibreYOLO/LibrePaddleOCRVL0.9b of PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR-VL (revision 7fa00a8c55b735ba51ba49a9058f3f9c57a99a11) with PaddlePaddle/PP-DocLayoutV2_safetensors (revision 880e8971b88938518611c54fc0f59ad57849c9d4) under layout/, shipping LICENSE and NOTICE. The recognizer's language model is initialized from Baidu's ERNIE-4.5-0.3B, also Apache-2.0.
